pairs.question: Sinite utraque crescere usque ad messem. Quare?
pairs.answer: Tales enim estis, ut falli possitis.
pairs.derivation: Augustine quotes the dominical command and poses his own one-word question 'quare?' answering it himself. The setup 'sinite utraque crescere usque ad messem' is kept so 'quare?' has a referent (why let both grow). The answer ends at the first full stop ('possitis'); what follows ('denique audi: ...') turns to a fresh exhortation/scriptural citation, not part of the answer. Capitalization of 'Sinite' and 'Tales' and terminal punctuation normalized; no Latin words added or reordered.
